items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk stocks take $1.5 trillion hit with fresh test in SpaceX lockup ahead
items.summary_cn: Musk旗下SpaceX在lockup测试前估值蒸发1.5万亿美元，kcn持仓SPCX和SPCH（2倍做多SpaceX ETF）直接承压。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX stock plunges. Is Elon Musk still the richest person in the world?
items.summary_cn: SpaceX股价大跌，Musk世界首富地位受质疑，kcn持有的SPCX与SPCH（2倍杠杆SpaceX ETF）受直接冲击。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk calls himself ‘former trillionaire’ as billions vanish amid Tesla, SpaceX crash. Why the rich laugh at losses
items.summary_cn: Musk自嘲'前万亿富翁'，Tesla与SpaceX估值双杀背景下，kcn的SpaceX相关杠杆敞口SPCX/SPCH持续承压。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Reality Bites Elon Musk and His Tesla, SpaceX Believers
items.summary_cn: Musk的Tesla与SpaceX'信徒'遭现实打击，估值神话被质疑，kcn的SPCX/SPCH等SpaceX杠杆持仓面临重新定价。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk’s Wealth Has Taken a Huge SpaceX Hit. He’s Still Worth 45 Times China’s CXMT Billionaire.
items.summary_cn: SpaceX估值大幅缩水，Musk身家仍是中国CXMT亿万富翁的45倍——kcn的SpaceX杠杆敞口SPCX/SPCH持续走弱。

items.author: Musk
items.text: As SpaceX Sheds a Tesla’s Worth of Value, Elon Musk Is Trying to Sell Investors on Another Company
items.summary_cn: SpaceX单轮蒸发相当于一整辆Tesla市值的价值，Musk转而向投资者推介其他公司，kcn的SPCX/SPCH持仓承压信号明显。

items.author: Trump
items.text: NVIDIA: Building in America, for America: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/made-in-usa/
items.summary_cn: Trump转发NVIDIA'在美国建、为美国建'宣传内容，间接背书NVDA本土制造叙事，对恒生科技ETF等AI敞口有情绪利好。

items.author: Trump
items.text: NVIDIA and Partners Build in America, for America: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-and-partners-build-in-america-for-america/
items.summary_cn: Trump转发NVIDIA与合作伙伴在美国本土建厂博文，强化'美国制造'主题，对AI/半导体板块情绪正面。

items.author: Musk
items.text: UK lawmaker suing Musk's xAI seeks order to stop Grok generating sexualised images
items.summary_cn: 英国议员起诉xAI并寻求禁令阻止Grok生成色情图像，xAI/AI监管风险上升，对AI板块情绪偏负面。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Tariffs pull, USMCA pushes: Toyota to Texas: https://thehill.com/opinion/white-house/5965989-toyota-texas-tacoma-tariffs-impact/
items.summary_cn: Trump关税推动叠加USMCA，Toyota将Tacoma生产线从墨西哥迁至德州，体现关税政策对汽车制造业回流的影响。

items.author: Trump
items.text: John Thune should not allow the United States  Senate to “leave town” until it passes The Save America Act or, far better still, TERMINATES THE FILIBUSTER, where Republicans can then quickly pass everything they ever dreamed of, including a full and deep throated SAVE AMERICA ACT, the Budget, and the ever looming Debt Ceiling disaster, 1929! The Dumocrats will do it on day one, and can’t believe how lucky they got with this Senate leadership. Remember, stupidity always brings LOSING & DEATH! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump施压参议院通过《Save America Act》、预算及债务上限法案，警告1929式金融危机，影响财政与利率预期。
